schema.text: Is there a space for cycling on this street?
schema.help: A school street is a street next to a school that is closed to motor traffic when children arrive and leave.

options.text: No space for bicycles: people cycle in ordinary traffic
No space for bicycles, but the limit is 30 km/h or it is a school street
Cycle lane or path, but it stops
Path shared by people walking and cycling

en.#Is there a space for cycling on this st: Is there a space for cycling on this street?
en.#A school street is a street next to a s: A school street is a street next to a school that is closed to motor traffic when children arrive and leave.
en.#No space for bicycles: people cycle in: No space for bicycles: people cycle in ordinary traffic
en.#No space for bicycles, but the limit is: No space for bicycles, but the limit is 30 km/h or it is a school street
en.#Cycle lane or path, but it stops: Cycle lane or path, but it stops
en.#Path shared by people walking and cycli: Path shared by people walking and cycling

it.#Is there a space for cycling on this st: C'è uno spazio destinato alle biciclette su questa strada?
it.#A school street is a street next to a s: Una strada scolastica è una via vicino a una scuola chiusa ai veicoli a motore all'entrata e all'uscita dei bambini.
it.#No space for bicycles: people cycle in: Nessuno spazio per le bici: si pedala nel traffico normale
it.#No space for bicycles, but the limit is: Nessuno spazio per le bici, ma c'è il limite di 30 km/h o è una strada scolastica
it.#Cycle lane or path, but it stops: Corsia o pista ciclabile, ma si interrompe
it.#Path shared by people walking and cycli: Percorso per pedoni e bici insieme

fr.#Is there a space for cycling on this st: Y a-t-il un espace pour les vélos dans cette rue ?
fr.#A school street is a street next to a s: Une rue scolaire est une rue près d’une école, fermée aux véhicules motorisés à l’arrivée et au départ des enfants.
fr.#No space for bicycles: people cycle in: Aucun espace pour les vélos : on roule dans la circulation normale
fr.#No space for bicycles, but the limit is: Aucun espace pour les vélos, mais la vitesse est limitée à 30 km/h ou c’est une rue scolaire
fr.#Cycle lane or path, but it stops: Bande ou piste cyclable, mais elle s'interrompt
fr.#Path shared by people walking and cycli: Chemin partagé entre piétons et cyclistes

de.#Is there a space for cycling on this st: Gibt es in dieser Straße Platz zum Radfahren?
de.#A school street is a street next to a s: Eine Schulstraße ist eine Straße an einer Schule, die beim Kommen und Gehen der Kinder für Kraftfahrzeuge gesperrt ist.
de.#No space for bicycles: people cycle in: Kein Platz für Fahrräder: man fährt im normalen Verkehr
de.#No space for bicycles, but the limit is: Kein Platz für Fahrräder, aber es gilt Tempo 30 oder es ist eine Schulstraße
de.#Cycle lane or path, but it stops: Radfahrstreifen oder Radweg, aber er hört auf

tr.#Is there a space for cycling on this st: Bu sokakta bisiklet için bir alan var mı?
tr.#A school street is a street next to a s: Okul sokağı, çocukların geliş ve çıkış saatlerinde motorlu araçlara kapatılan, okulun yanındaki sokaktır.
tr.#No space for bicycles: people cycle in: Bisiklet için alan yok: normal trafikte sürülüyor
tr.#No space for bicycles, but the limit is: Bisiklet için alan yok, ama hız sınırı 30 km/sa veya bir okul sokağı
tr.#Cycle lane or path, but it stops: Bisiklet şeridi veya yolu var, ama kesiliyor
tr.#Path shared by people walking and cycli: Yayalar ve bisikletliler için ortak yol

fa.#Is there a space for cycling on this st: آیا در این خیابان فضایی برای دوچرخه‌سواری وجود دارد؟
fa.#A school street is a street next to a s: خیابان مدرسه خیابانی کنار مدرسه است که هنگام رسیدن و رفتن کودکان به روی وسایل نقلیه موتوری بسته می‌شود.
fa.#No space for bicycles: people cycle in: فضایی برای دوچرخه نیست: در ترافیک عادی رکاب زده می‌شود
fa.#No space for bicycles, but the limit is: فضایی برای دوچرخه نیست، اما محدودیت سرعت ۳۰ کیلومتر است یا خیابان مدرسه است
fa.#Cycle lane or path, but it stops: خط یا مسیر دوچرخه هست، اما قطع می‌شود
fa.#Path shared by people walking and cycli: مسیر مشترک عابران پیاده و دوچرخه‌سواران

hu.#Is there a space for cycling on this st: Van hely a kerékpározásra ezen az utcán?
hu.#A school street is a street next to a s: Az iskolautca egy iskola melletti utca, amelyet a gyerekek érkezésekor és távozásakor lezárnak a gépjárművek elől.
hu.#No space for bicycles: people cycle in: Nincs hely a kerékpároknak: a normál forgalomban kell tekerni
hu.#No space for bicycles, but the limit is: Nincs hely a kerékpároknak, de 30 km/h a sebességkorlát, vagy iskolautca

ar.#Is there a space for cycling on this st: هل توجد مساحة لركوب الدراجات في هذا الشارع؟
ar.#A school street is a street next to a s: الشارع المدرسي هو شارع قرب مدرسة يُغلق أمام المركبات الآلية عند وصول الأطفال ومغادرتهم.
ar.#No space for bicycles: people cycle in: لا توجد مساحة للدراجات: تُقاد الدراجة وسط حركة المرور العادية
ar.#No space for bicycles, but the limit is: لا توجد مساحة للدراجات، لكن حد السرعة 30 كم/س أو إنه شارع مدرسي
ar.#Cycle lane or path, but it stops: مسار أو ممر للدراجات، لكنه ينقطع
